description: Graphite sketch showing bust of a young man. The bust is done in the classical style, the man is shown with a wreath in his hair and a drape that clasps together over the shoulder on the left side and extends across the chest to wrap over the shoulder on the right. A strap is also shown extending from the shoulder on the left down to the torso. The drawing is positioned in the center and fills most of the space on the paper. The bust is looking off towards the right side of the paper.
title: Untitled (Bust)
